"""Validate scoped observer row ownership and non-overlapping cycle accounting."""
import json
import torch
from tools.thor.model_bench import ModelAdapter

with torch.inference_mode():
 a=ModelAdapter('native',1024,1,cache_capacity=1125);a.reset();a.run();torch.cuda.synchronize()
 diag=a.globs.diag.cpu().tolist();ops=a.globs.instructions[:,:,0].cpu().tolist();checked=0
 for rows,opcodes in zip(diag,ops):
  for row,op in zip(rows,opcodes):
   if op in (1,4,5,6,7):
    assert row[10]==op and row[11]>0 and min(row)>=0
    assert sum(row[:3])<=row[3] and row[4]+row[5]<=row[6] and row[7]<=row[8]
    checked+=1
 assert checked==3028
 print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','observer_rows_checked':checked}))
